title: Skirmish
summary: A battle against computer players on a generated map. Your colony stays saved.
text:
**SKIRMISH** (title screen, or the menu) sets up a battle away from the story: 2 to 4 players, free for all, you against everyone, or 2 against 2. Pick the world, the size, how much sea, how rough the ground, the map seed (with a preview), starting alloys, fog of war and whether wildlife and packs join in.

Each player has a colour. Up close, a vehicle shows it on its trim (the stripes, the patches on its deck and its glowing strips); zoomed out, the whole vehicle takes it, so armies are easy to tell apart.

Computer players come in **Easy**, **Normal** and **Hard**. They build bases, scout, research and attack in waves. There's no cryo bank or colonists: the last player (or team) standing wins.

Your campaign is saved first, so CONTINUE takes you back to your colony afterwards.
